sample_input: I ordered the standing desk on May 3rd. The delivery was two weeks late and nobody answered my emails. When it finally arrived, one leg was scratched, but assembly was easy and the motor is quiet. I'd buy again if shipping improves.

3. 整體評價偏正面，若出貨體驗改善，願意再次購買。
